note: Zambia, read on the Department of Immigration's own pages on 2026-10-30: its permit types and its public notice of revised fees in force from 19 August 2024 (Statutory Instrument No. 25 of 2024). An Employment Permit is for a foreigner entering to take up employment for more than six months; only an employer, a practising lawyer or an immigration consultant may apply for it, the applicant staying outside Zambia until it is approved; the holder may engage only in the employment the permit specifies. It can be extended up to a maximum of 10 years (the 10 kept as its term, the longest a holder keeps it). Issue costs ZMW 24,000 in the private sector (renewal 28,000; 10,667 for government and non-profit employers). The Residence Permit confers permanent residence on, among others, one who has held an Employment Permit continuously for more than ten years (10 kept); its issue costs ZMW 20,000; the work it allows is read as any, as permanent residence. A Temporary Employment Permit (up to six months in twelve, ZMW 18,000) serves a business visitor and leads nowhere. Decision times, the investor's permit, and naturalisation's count aren't written.

sources.title: Zambia Department of Immigration, Immigration Permit Types
sources.said: A Residence Permit confers permanent residence to a holder and is issued to a foreigner who: has held an Employment Permit for a continuous period exceeding ten (10) years; ... An Employment Permit is issued to a foreigner who enters the country to take up employment for a period exceeding six (06) months. It can be extended for periods up to a maximum of 10 years. ... All applicants should remain outside Zambia until the permit has been approved. Further, only an Employer, a Practising Lawyer and an Immigration Consult can apply for Employment Permits on behalf of a prospective expatriate.
